contracts.note: Defined in the Phase 6 design (rules C-01 to C-06) and gated on the contracts aggregates publishing with a valid record. No contracts signal has been computed; this engine is present as a labelled state, never as an empty or zero-filled result.

languageRules.framing: Research lead — [plain-language descriptive name]. [Entity] reported [measure value] versus a peer-group median of [peer median] among [peer n] [peer-group plain description] ([percentile band] within that group). Computed from [dataset names and versions]. A research lead is a reason to look closer; it is not a finding about the entity, and most entities above any statistical band have ordinary explanations (case mix, specialty practice patterns, contract type, reporting practices).
standing: Anomalies are research leads — never declarations about an entity, never a statement of how likely wrongdoing is, never a grade of an entity.
Missing or not computed is a labelled state, never zero, never imputed, never silently absent.
